finding: The evaluation-like demo set overlays sparse class-correlated outliers on training-like signals.
evidence_chain: Kurtosis-family features drift up to 8.4 sigma between train and demo, within class (not a class-composition effect).
Demo per-class standardized kurtosis 2.8 -> 8.4 while trimmed kurtosis (|z_MAD|<=4 kept) is unchanged (2.97 vs 3.07): the tails, not the core signal, changed.
Fraction of samples beyond 5 robust deviations rises 3x (0.0002 -> 0.0006).
On demo, standardized kurtosis separates class 7 (11.3) from class 6 (5.1) by 13.9 sigma of the train spread; in train that separation is 0.2 sigma.
response: Inference-time despiking: replace samples beyond 5 robust deviations (median/MAD) with the channel median, implemented in core_features.despike (numba, bitwise-equal to the numpy reference). No model retraining; no demo labels used.
clip_level_selection: Seven configurations (clip 3.5-5.0, winsorize vs median-replace) evaluated on the demo; median-replace at 5.0 selected. This is a single-parameter selection on 400 labeled rows and is documented as such.

results.latency: despike adds ~0.18 ms; full predict unchanged within machine noise (A/B: 2.1-2.4 ms both packages)

rejected_alternatives.demo_label_offsets: 8 offsets fitted on 200 demo rows, evaluated on the untouched 200: accuracy -2.5 to -4.5 pp in three seeds. In-sample-only gain; rejected.
rejected_alternatives.demo_label_6v7_specialist: 46-50 percent heldout accuracy on the binary task (chance); the class pair is near-indistinguishable at the demo's corruption level with 25 examples per class.
rejected_alternatives.corruption_augmented_training: Robustness to simulated outlier/noise/NaN corruption (+7 pp on simulated shift) did not transfer to demo (77.0 percent vs 77.25 shipped; the mixed variant 75.3).
rejected_alternatives.spike_feature_specialists: Pre-clip robust spike features (robust kurtosis, outlier rates, max deviation per channel) separate demo 6/7 only weakly (AUC 0.77-0.86 per channel; best single thresholds 55-60 percent). A gated specialist combining them with clip features matched chance on split-half heldout rows (pool accuracy 0.46-0.59 across seeds and margins) and moved overall accuracy by -1.5 to +1.0 pp.
rejected_alternatives.model_ensembles: Averaging the shipped model with corruption-augmented variants: 79.8-81.3 percent, all below the single shipped model's 81.5.

accuracy_ceiling_note: Total demo errors at the shipped configuration: 74 of 400 (81.5 percent). 44 of them sit in the class 6/7 pool, which measures 46-60 percent heldout accuracy for every separator tested (main model, spike features, combined specialists, prototypes); even a perfect pool resolver would reach 92.5 percent, but no tested approach exceeds ~60 percent pool accuracy out-of-sample, putting the honest ceiling near 84-85 percent. Reaching beyond that requires labeled data drawn from the evaluation generator (a larger labeled eval-like set or the generator's per-class parameters), which participants do not have.
